pricingPage.title: Start free. Grow when you need to.
pricingPage.intro: Every plan includes templates, the drag-and-drop editor and a 3D world for your page.
pricingPage.seoDescription: Simple plans for personal websites and 3D worlds. Start free, upgrade for more pages, themes and extras.

faq.q: Can I really use Perlink for free?
faq.a: Yes. The free plan lets you create and publish a page with its own 3D world.

Choose a plan in your dashboard and pay online; payments are handled by our reseller Lemon Squeezy. Your plan turns on as soon as the payment goes through, and you can cancel any time. In Vietnam you can also pay by bank transfer (VietQR).
Yes, you can move up or down at any time.

faq.q: What happens to my page if I downgrade?
faq.a: Your page stays online at the same address.
